# SAM2 pin

`docker/Dockerfile` (trainer) and `SegmentationServer/Dockerfile` (server) pin `facebookresearch/sam2` at
`SAM2_GIT_SHA`; the server's `segmentation_server/pyproject.toml` names the same SHA (its `test_stub_sync.py` checks
the pair). Keep all three equal.

When editing those files or SAM2 integration, check https://github.com/facebookresearch/sam2/commits/main. If `main` is
newer than the pinned SHA, tell James and do not silently unpin unless he asks.

For theory + API grounding before SAM2 plans or code changes, use `.cursor/skills/sam2-grounding/`.
